This plot is only 0.21 hectares, and I plant faba beans here to rotate with my teff and wheat lands. I do not receive enough chemical fertilizer from the cooperative to cover this small plot, so I will spread composted cow manure that I prepared during the dry season instead. I have kept my own seeds from last year’s harvest, and my children and I will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves when the meher rains come.
